svg.title: Zenith — Cloud Resource Optimization Platform Logo
svg.desc: A geometric logo mark for Zenith showing an upward-pointing peak rising above layered cloud arcs, rendered in deep charcoal with warm gold accents. Below the mark is the wordmark "Zenith" with subtitle "Cloud Optimization".
svg.text: Typeface: Inter / Outfit · Weight 500 wordmark · Weight 400 subtitle
Works on: #030303 dark UI · #f5f2eb warm light UI · transparent bg
